product_detail.description:
Motorola Moto G34 5G

The Motorola Moto G34 5G is a versatile smartphone designed for everyday communication, entertainment and productivity. With 5G connectivity, a smooth 120Hz display and a capable Snapdragon processor, it offers practical features for daily smartphone use.

Its 6.5-inch IPS LCD display features a 120Hz refresh rate and 720 × 1600 resolution for smooth scrolling and comfortable viewing. The Qualcomm Snapdragon 695 5G processor supports everyday applications, browsing, multitasking and entertainment.

The phone is available with different memory configurations, including up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. The microSDXC card slot provides additional storage expansion, although it shares the SIM slot.

Capture everyday moments with the 50MP main rear camera and 2MP macro camera. The 16MP front camera is suitable for selfies and video calls, with both cameras supporting 1080p video recording at 30fps.

A 5000mAh battery with 18W wired charging helps support everyday use. Additional features include stereo speakers, Snapdragon Sound, a 3.5mm headphone jack, USB Type-C connectivity and a side-mounted fingerprint sensor.

The Motorola Moto G34 5G also features a water-repellent design and comes in attractive color options, including Charcoal Black, Ice Blue, Ocean Green and Vanilla Cream.

Motorola Moto G34 5G is a practical choice for users looking for 5G connectivity, a high-refresh-rate display, versatile cameras and a long-lasting battery for everyday activities.

Note: RAM, storage, operating system, SIM configuration, NFC availability, back material and weight may vary by model and region. Please confirm the selected variant before ordering.

product_detail.description:
Infinix SMART 20

The Infinix SMART 20 is designed for everyday smartphone users who need a large display, practical performance, useful connectivity and reliable battery capacity for daily activities.

Its 6.78-inch IPS LCD display features a smooth 120Hz refresh rate and up to 700 nits HBM brightness. The MediaTek Helio G81 Ultimate processor and 4GB RAM support everyday tasks such as browsing, messaging, social media and multimedia playback.

With 64GB or 128GB internal storage and a dedicated microSDXC card slot, you can store your essential apps, photos, videos and documents with additional expansion options.

Capture everyday moments with the 8MP autofocus rear camera and take selfies or make video calls using the 8MP front camera. Both cameras support video recording at the resolutions listed in the specifications.

The 5200mAh battery supports 15W wired charging and 5W reverse wired charging. Additional features include a side-mounted fingerprint sensor, dual Nano-SIM, NFC, infrared port, FM radio and a 3.5mm headphone jack.

Running Android 16 with XOS 16, the Infinix SMART 20 combines practical everyday features with a slim design, IP64 dust and splash resistance, and multiple color options.

Infinix SMART 20 is a practical option for users looking for an affordable everyday smartphone for communication, entertainment and daily productivity.

Note: Storage options, colors and specifications may vary by region and selected model.

Acer Chromebook 314 (C933/C933T)

The Acer Chromebook 314 is designed for students, professionals and everyday users who need a practical laptop for web browsing, online learning and productivity. Its large 14-inch display provides a comfortable workspace for documents, websites and classroom projects.

Powered by an Intel processor, this Chromebook combines responsive performance with efficient power usage. The anti-glare display coating helps provide comfortable viewing in bright environments, while the narrow 7.3mm bezel creates a more spacious viewing experience. Touchscreen functionality is available on selected configurations.

With a manufacturer-rated battery life of up to 12.5 hours under specified testing conditions, the Acer Chromebook 314 is designed to support extended work and study sessions without frequent charging.

Its shock-absorbing bumper design and MIL-STD 810G impact-resistance testing provide additional durability features. These characteristics make the Acer Chromebook 314 a practical option for educational environments and everyday computing.

Choose the Acer Chromebook 314 for a large display, convenient connectivity, ChromeOS functionality and a design suited to daily productivity.

Infinix HOT 70

Experience smooth everyday performance with the Infinix HOT 70, a feature-packed smartphone designed for entertainment, communication and daily productivity. It combines a large 120Hz display, an efficient processor, versatile cameras and a high-capacity battery.

The 6.78-inch IPS LCD display features a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 700 nits HBM brightness for smooth scrolling and comfortable everyday viewing. Its MediaTek Helio G100 Ultimate 6nm processor supports everyday apps, multitasking and multimedia activities.

With RAM configurations of up to 8GB and storage options of up to 256GB, the Infinix HOT 70 provides space for your applications, photos, videos and other important files. A dedicated microSDXC slot allows additional storage expansion.

Capture everyday moments with the 50MP autofocus rear camera and take selfies using the 8MP front camera. Both cameras support video recording at resolutions listed in the product specifications.

The powerful 6000mAh battery supports 45W wired charging, along with 10W reverse wired charging and bypass charging. Stereo speakers, a 3.5mm headphone jack, NFC and an infrared port add extra convenience.

Built with IP65 dust and water resistance and stated drop resistance up to 1.5 metres, the Infinix HOT 70 combines practical durability with a slim design. It runs Android 16 with XOS 16 and is available in several stylish colors.

Infinix HOT 70 is a suitable choice for users looking for a large display, everyday performance, versatile connectivity and a high-capacity battery.

Note: RAM, storage and color availability depend on the selected variant and market.

The Motorola Moto G17 is an everyday smartphone featuring a large 6.72-inch Full HD+ IPS LCD display with 1080 × 2400 pixel resolution, up to 1050 nits HBM brightness and Corning Gorilla Glass 3 protection.

iPhone Duo Fold 5G - Brand New

The iPhone Fold is Apple's premium foldable smartphone, combining a large immersive display with a compact cover screen. Its sophisticated Grade 5 titanium frame and hinge provide a premium and durable design.

🖥️ Immersive Foldable Display

When unfolded, the device offers a large 7.6-inch LTPO Super Retina XDR OLED display with 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10 and Dolby Vision. The cover display measures 5.4 inches and provides convenient access when the phone is folded.

⚡ Next-Generation Performance

Powered by the Apple A20 Pro 2nm chipset with a 7-core Apple GPU, the iPhone Fold is designed for powerful everyday performance. It comes with 12GB RAM and storage options from 256GB up to 2TB.

The dual rear camera system combines a 48MP Main camera and 48MP Ultra Wide camera. The phone also features an under-display front camera and a dedicated 12MP cover camera.

🌐 Advanced Connectivity

Stay connected with 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, NFC and USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2. The device also supports GPS, UWB and satellite-based emergency features.

🔋 Fast Charging

The iPhone Fold supports fast wired charging and 25W MagSafe/Qi2 wireless charging for convenient everyday charging.

The OnePlus 15 5G is a flagship smartphone built for high-performance gaming, photography, entertainment and everyday use. It combines a powerful Snapdragon processor with a 165Hz LTPO AMOLED display and a large 7300mAh battery.

With 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, NFC, infrared, USB Type-C 3.2, stereo speakers and IP68/IP69K protection, the OnePlus 15 5G offers a complete flagship smartphone experience.

product_detail.description:
Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds

The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds are premium true wireless earbuds engineered to deliver exceptional sound quality and industry-leading active noise cancellation. Bose's CustomTune technology intelligently calibrates both the audio and ANC performance to your ears, creating a personalized listening experience.

Featuring Bose Immersive Audio, Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint connectivity, Snapdragon Sound support, and AI-enhanced call quality, these earbuds are ideal for music, entertainment, and everyday communication. The secure Fit Kit with multiple eartips and stability bands ensures a comfortable fit for extended listening sessions.

With up to 6 hours of battery life, an IPX4 water-resistant design, USB-C charging, and the Bose App for customization, the QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds offer a premium wireless audio experience for commuting, travel, work, and daily use.

product_detail.description:
Fujifilm instax mini 12 Instant Camera

The Fujifilm instax mini 12 is a playful and easy-to-use instant camera designed for bright, fun photos with minimal effort. Its automatic exposure system adjusts shutter speed and flash output based on the environment, making it simple to capture well-lit shots in a variety of lighting conditions.

The camera includes a dedicated Close-up mode for subjects at 30 to 50 cm, along with a built-in selfie mirror to help frame portraits and selfies accurately. It uses FUJIFILM instax mini instant film, producing prints with a picture size of 62 × 46 mm.

Powered by two AA-size alkaline batteries, the instax mini 12 also includes automatic film ejection, a film counter, a film pack confirmation window, and a quick development time of about 90 seconds. Its compact body and colorful design make it a great choice for everyday instant photography and sharing physical prints with friends.

product_detail.description:
Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 (SM-X133)

The Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 (SM-X133) is a stylish and portable Android tablet designed for entertainment, online learning, and everyday productivity. Its slim and lightweight design makes it easy to carry, while the 8.7-inch display delivers an enjoyable viewing experience for videos, reading, and web browsing.

Powered by an efficient octa-core processor with 4GB RAM and 64GB internal storage, the Galaxy Tab A11 offers reliable performance for multitasking and daily applications. The storage can be expanded up to 2TB using a microSD card, giving you plenty of room for photos, videos, and files.

Equipped with an 8MP rear camera, 5MP front camera, Dolby Atmos audio, Wi-Fi connectivity, Bluetooth 5.3, and a 5100mAh battery, the Galaxy Tab A11 is an excellent choice for students, families, and users looking for a dependable tablet at an affordable price.

product_detail.key_features:
Patrol Automatic Luxury Watch

The Patrol Automatic Luxury Watch is a stylish and premium wristwatch designed for users who want a luxury look with automatic mechanical movement. Its skeleton open dial design gives a modern and classy appearance, making it perfect for fashion lovers and watch collectors.

This watch features a silver metal strap, clear analog display, and premium stainless steel style body. The automatic movement gives a classic watch experience without the need for a battery, making it both stylish and practical for daily use.

With its attractive gift box packaging, the Patrol Automatic Luxury Watch is a great choice for birthdays, anniversaries, Eid gifts, office gifts, and special occasions. It is suitable for office wear, casual outfits, parties, business meetings, and everyday fashion use.

product_detail.description:
Xiaomi POCO F8 Ultra

The Xiaomi POCO F8 Ultra is the most advanced flagship smartphone in the POCO F8 series, combining top-tier performance, professional-grade cameras, and premium multimedia features. Its immersive 6.9-inch HyperRGB AMOLED display offers vibrant colors, Dolby Vision®, HDR10+, and a smooth 120Hz refresh rate for an exceptional viewing experience.

Powered by the cutting-edge Qualcomm Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 processor and running Android 16 with Xiaomi HyperOS 3, the POCO F8 Ultra delivers outstanding speed, AI-powered productivity, and ultra-smooth gaming. The VisionBoost D8 chipset, LPDDR5X memory, and UFS 4.1 storage ensure flagship-level responsiveness and efficiency.

Capture stunning photos and cinematic videos using the advanced triple-camera system featuring a 50MP Light Fusion 950 main sensor, a 50MP 5x periscope telephoto camera, and a 50MP ultra-wide camera with support for 8K recording. A long-lasting 6500mAh battery with 100W wired and 50W wireless HyperCharge keeps you powered throughout the day, while IP68 protection, Wi-Fi 7, Sound by Bose, and an ultrasonic fingerprint sensor complete the premium flagship experience.

Samsung Galaxy A57 5G

The Samsung Galaxy A57 5G combines a stylish design, a vibrant Super AMOLED+ display, capable cameras, and 5G connectivity in a slim smartphone. Its 6.7-inch display features a 120Hz refresh rate and HDR10+ support for smooth scrolling and an enjoyable viewing experience.

Immersive Display

Enjoy videos, games, browsing, and everyday apps on the 6.7-inch Super AMOLED+ display. With Full HD+ resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and high-brightness support, the screen delivers detailed visuals and smooth motion.

Performance and Storage

Powered by the Exynos 1680 4nm processor and Xclipse 550 GPU, the Galaxy A57 5G is designed for everyday multitasking, entertainment, and gaming. Storage configurations include 128GB, 256GB, and 512GB, with 8GB or 12GB RAM depending on the variant.

Versatile Camera System

The triple rear camera system includes a 50MP main camera with optical image stabilization, a 12MP ultrawide camera, and a 5MP macro camera. The 12MP front camera supports selfies and video recording, while the rear camera can record video at up to 4K resolution at 30fps.

Battery and Charging

The 5000mAh battery is designed to keep up with daily use. The device supports 45W wired charging, helping you recharge with a compatible charger.

Durable and Modern Design

The phone features a glass front and back with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus+ and an aluminum frame. Its IP68 rating indicates dust protection and water resistance under specified test conditions, including immersion in up to 1.5 metres of water for 30 minutes.

Connectivity and Security

Stay connected with 5G, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 6.0, USB Type-C, and a range of supported positioning systems. An optical fingerprint sensor integrated beneath the display provides convenient device unlocking.

Available Configurations

The Samsung Galaxy A57 5G is listed in Navy, Gray, Icyblue, and Lilac. RAM, storage, SIM configuration, and NFC availability may vary by model and region.

Powered by an efficient Intel Core i5/i7 processor, this device delivers smooth multitasking and reliable performance for office applications, browsing, and business tasks. The sleek aluminum design gives it a premium look while maintaining durability.

Featuring a high-resolution touchscreen display, backlit keyboard, and advanced security features, the EliteBook x360 ensures a comfortable and secure user experience. Its lightweight build and long battery life make it ideal for professionals on the go.

Whether you're attending meetings, creating presentations, or working remotely, the HP EliteBook x360 1030 G3 provides a perfect combination of power, style, and versatility.

product_detail.description:
Calus Fast 500 Power Bank – 50000 mAh

The Calus Fast 500 Power Bank is a high‑capacity portable battery pack designed to provide long‑lasting backup power for smartphones, tablets, and other USB‑powered devices. With a massive 50000 mAh rated capacity, it’s suited for long trips, outdoor use, emergencies, or situations where access to wall charging is limited.

This power bank supports super fast charging (up to 22.5 W) and features multiple output ports, including USB‑C, USB‑A, and Micro‑USB, allowing you to charge several devices simultaneously. An LED display shows real‑time battery level for convenience.

With built‑in safety protections against overcharge, short circuits, and overheating, it aims to keep both the power bank and connected devices safe during use.
